decision.reason: The CAS IPT archive directly identifies CAS SU(ICH) catalog 14524, a dated preserved specimen with country/province/waterBody/locality text naming Balayan Bay and a CC0 1.0 license. This is eligible only as historical text-locality evidence; no coordinate or present-day claim is made. Balayan Bay is outside the current Cavite public pilot, so no app row is added.

decision.interpretation: Six CAS SU(ICH) lots are admitted only as historical source-locality research evidence after direct institutional archive, source-rights and accepted-name checks. Source dates retain day- or month-precision. Numeric catalog numbers also occur in the CAS ICH collection, so institution, collection and catalog number must be joined together. All GBIF quality flags remain visible; the two Liza spelling forms resolve to the same accepted species. Public app, map and coordinate admission remain false because Balayan Bay is in Batangas, outside the current Cavite pilot.
